mapper.update: UPDATE game SET remain_stock = remain_stock + 1, total_stock = total_stock + 1 WHERE game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.select: SELECT -- game表所有字段（按实际表结构补充） g.game_id AS gameId, g.game_name AS gameName, g.game_original_price AS gameOriginalPrice, g.release_date AS releaseDate, g.main_image_url AS mainImageUrl, g.version AS version, g.created_at AS createdAt, g.updated_at AS updatedAt, g.remain_stock AS remainStock, g.total_stock AS totalStock, g.status AS status, -- 关联game_profile表的标签字段 gp.game_tag_name AS gameTagName FROM game g -- 左连接game_profile，确保game表数据都能返回 LEFT JOIN game_profile gp ON g.game_id = gp.game_id
